country.note: Brave documents it for search results; not checked live, so country is not mapped to it.

language.note: 'es' answered in English and an unknown value was accepted live, so locale is not mapped to it.

safesearch.note: off, moderate or strict; no normalized field.

max_completion_tokens.note: Caps the answer; a cut-off answer is partial.

web_search_options.note: search_context_size low, medium or high; no normalized field.

enable_research.note: Brave's multi-search research mode; it cannot run with enable_citations, and research() is its own method.
